title: Model discovery gets a reliability filter
summary:
Model catalogs can filter by reliability, route health is easier to inspect, Scout has clearer limits, and `polli` can update itself when asked.

Quest contributions added source and reliability filters across model catalogs, plus a route-health endpoint that separates primary-route failures from successful fallback rescues. The model monitor now shows route breakdowns and flags unhealthy primaries even when callers receive a successful response. The generated API reference also picked up the current chat model list.

The team restored `meta/llama-4-scout` with a new primary and fallback route. It still supports text and image input and streaming, but no longer supports tool calling or structured output; its declared context window is now 131,072 tokens. Chat Completions and Responses reject requests that exceed declared limits or use unsupported capabilities up front.

The community app catalog gained PollenBatch for trying image variations before regenerating a selection at high resolution, and AI Flashcards for turning content into study cards. The README's Latest News was refreshed with the previous day's entries.

daily.title: Filter models by reliability
daily.text: Filter model lists by official or community source, or request only models with fresh, reliable health status. Headers offer the same filters when a client cannot add query parameters. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Inspect health by route
daily.text: The new `/v1/models/status/routes` endpoint separates caller-visible results from individual primary and fallback attempts, so a successful rescue does not hide a failing route. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: See fallback rescues
daily.text: Expand models in the monitor to see route health and rescue counts, including a warning when an unhealthy primary is masked by a working fallback. [Open the model monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Update polli on demand
daily.text: Run `polli update` to check for and install the latest globally installed `@pollinations/cli`. Nothing installs automatically. [View the CLI package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Build with shared chat UI
daily.text: Use reusable conversation, message, prompt-input, and tool-call components from `@pollinations/ui` in React apps. [Explore the React UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
